app.name: Resort-Feel Golf Lab v0.7
app.short_description: MotionPlus golf swing and 3D range lab
app.long_description: Original Wii homebrew golf research prototype. Power is driven primarily by backswing depth; Wii MotionPlus wrist rotation influences club face and shot curve. Includes rounded golfer/ball geometry, smoother terrain, improved camera behavior and ball flight physics. B resets stance, hold A to address and swing, D-pad aims/changes clubs, + resets shot, HOME exits.
